scope.purpose: Deterministic cumulative RAFT date routing; navigation and requirements only.

date_classes.export_use: Only eligible Darwin response/grounding date; split transcript at explicitly dated response sections when a letter spans dates. Preserve supplied uncertainty and section ordering in sidecar.
date_classes.fallback: Hold if no defensible response/section date.

date_classes.export_use: Identity and chronology evidence only; never substitute for response date.
Availability constraint and evidence for response scope; never transcript date unless the response section itself is dated.
date_classes.fallback: Use interval/unknown exactly; do not collapse to a day.

date_classes.export_use: Sidecar knowledge witness only; may bound what Darwin could know, but cannot date the transcript or turn incoming prose into Darwin grounding.
date_classes.fallback: Null means no demonstrated knowledge date.

date_classes.export_use: Eligibility hold/upper bound only; never replace response date.
date_classes.fallback: Hold affected entry when strict chronology cannot be established.

date_classes.export_use: Permit only the cited later response span; earlier paragraphs remain unconditioned. Keep event time and response date separate.

representative_pins.finding: 1400 composition order places P2 at noon, P3 at 13:00/15:00 and P1 at 16:00; 1406 receipt of 1404 is within P3 at 08:00, and 1414 receives 1412 during P1 before noon. Route these as section/event constraints, not a single nominal letter date.

The accepted Gray→Darwin exchange dates the response to Aug 24, while the incoming docket evidence says 1934 was received Aug 20. The sidecar explicitly says receipt fixes availability, not complete reading; transcript date remains response date.

The Coe samples are admitted as content-use knowledge with a conservative latest composition/publication bound, while missing October Darwin letters remain unlocated. Route this as sidecar evidence, never as an exact receipt or transcript date.

routing_mechanisms.name: response_date_resolver
routing_mechanisms.output: one ISO date or explicitly held section spans
routing_mechanisms.rule: Prefer exact/section-dated Darwin response composition evidence; reject incoming/receipt/known-by/latest-bound substitution.

routing_mechanisms.name: availability_gate
routing_mechanisms.rule: Require incoming evidence to precede the response section; preserve null/interval precision and do not manufacture reading or delivery.

routing_mechanisms.name: section_splitter
routing_mechanisms.rule: Emit only the cited Darwin paragraph/code-point scope; later arrival cannot condition earlier prose; one response section per transcript.

routing_mechanisms.name: strict_retrieval_filter
routing_mechanisms.rule: Use date_num < transcript_date; null/unparseable dates are held out of strict historical retrieval, and same-day material is excluded.

routing_mechanisms.name: dedupe_and_sidecar
routing_mechanisms.output: one transcript per demonstrated response plus audit sidecar
routing_mechanisms.rule: Several accepted inputs may feed one response; deduplicate shared response bodies and retain all edge/date provenance outside RAFT text.

unresolved_date_classes: Darwin letters with only broad XML ranges or inferred years and no defensible response/section date.
Incoming dates or physical receipt intervals where the response scope is known but exact reading time is not.
Dated annotations, later editorial labels, publication dates, and third-party witnesses that establish knowledge or an upper bound without dating Darwin composition.
Multi-day letters whose response paragraphs are not separable at a supported section/code-point boundary.
Joint, copied, forwarded, or mixed-voice material where a date is available but Darwin-authored export scope is not.
finite_action_list: Build a cumulative manifest from accepted primary ledgers only, retaining ledger path/hash, accepted relation type, endpoint IDs, and exact response scope.
Resolve each candidate transcript date from Darwin response composition/section evidence; fail closed on incoming-only, receipt-only, known-by-only, publication-bound, null, or unresolved dates.
Apply section splits and chronology gates before constructing question/answer or grounding content; require incoming evidence and each source pin to precede the resolved response date.
Deduplicate by response endpoint plus scope, while recording multiple incoming edges and all date/voice evidence in an external audit sidecar.

Run per-entry checks for source identity, Darwin authority, date validity, strict earlier-than retrieval, excluded apparatus, held/third-party/joint material, and exact quote/hash spans; produce a gap report for every held item.
Reconcile totals across periods and additive primary corrections through 24 Nov 1859 before any single cumulative export; this candidate does not authorize export or training.

checks_run: SHA-256 recomputed for all listed input files
ledger field paths inspected against live JSON
validation.remaining: A future exporter must implement and independently test these rules against every accepted entry and rendered output.
